audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Praise, judgment, nations, bloodshed, oppressed people, Sheol, and acrostic structure.

verses.restored: I will praise thee, O YHWH, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

familiar.text: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

notes.title: Psalm 9–10 acrostic relationship
notes.body: Psalms 9 and 10 show complementary portions of an alphabetic acrostic and are combined as one psalm in some ancient traditions. Their separation in the Hebrew/KJV numbering is preserved here.

verses.restored: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

familiar.text: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

verses.restored: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

familiar.text: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

verses.restored: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

familiar.text: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

verses.restored: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

familiar.text: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

verses.restored: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

familiar.text: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

verses.restored: But the YHWH shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

familiar.text: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

verses.restored: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

familiar.text: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

verses.restored: The YHWH also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

familiar.text: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

verses.restored: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, YHWH, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

familiar.text: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

verses.restored: Sing praises to the YHWH, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

familiar.text: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

verses.restored: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

familiar.text: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

verses.restored: Have mercy upon me, O YHWH; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

familiar.text: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

verses.restored: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

familiar.text: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.restored: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

familiar.text: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

verses.restored: The YHWH is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

familiar.text: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

verses.restored: The wicked return to Sheol—all nations that forget God.

familiar.text: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

verses.restored: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

familiar.text: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

verses.restored: Arise, O YHWH; let not man prevail: let the nations be judged in thy sight.

familiar.text: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

verses.restored: Put them in fear, O YHWH: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

familiar.text: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: Ancient nation-language cannot be transferred to modern ethnic or religious targets. Divine judgment is not human permission for collective punishment.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Audit Psalms 9–10 together for alphabetic-acrostic structure and numbering differences across traditions.
